card.name: Renal function monitoring and word endings
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "function" right after "renal" in instructions to monitor or evaluate kidney function. It also fires on the closing piece of a few medical words, such as Electroly-tes or meloxic-am.

modes.label: Renal function
modes.description: The word "function" following "renal" in monitoring or evaluation instructions.
modes.example: Evaluate renal<< function>> prior to initiation of mesalamine delayed

modes.label: Ends of medical words
modes.description: The last piece of a drug or lab term split into parts, or a heading word.
modes.example: Electroly<<tes>> should be monitored during concomitant use

card.plain: It lights up on "function" in "renal function" when the label says to check the kidneys, and on the ends of some split medical words.
